coordinate_frame: CAD metres +Y; FBX -Y/Z; UE reflects Y once

reference_layout.authority: User approved replacing external CAD layout with the reference image on 2026-11-02. Pixel traces are appearance reconstruction, not surveyed geography.

calibration.coordinate_frame: CAD metres, +X east, +Y north, Z up; pixels origin top-left
calibration.fitting_method: Normalized DLT roof homography initialization; multistart finite-difference Levenberg-Marquardt pinhole fit with square pixels; 16 roof corners + 4 visible wall-base checks.
limitations: Manual pixel picks are approximate (typically 1-3px), and AI-generated reference need not obey a single exact perspective camera.
CAD main-building footprint and roof13.4m/ground-1.2m are preserved as the visual scale anchor; other exterior layout is free to follow the reference.
Wall-base points have 0.65 residual weight because lower edges are less certain; principal-point offsets have weak 200px prior, focal has weak log prior to regularize one-view ambiguity.
image_to_ground intersects a ray with a horizontal plane. To place a roof-derived footprint, use z=ground_z+estimated_height; using ground z for roof pixels shifts the building.
This is an art-reference best-fit camera, not photogrammetric survey accuracy. Reprojection residuals remain visible in the diagnostic overlay.

planting.exclusion_policy: Projected crown positions; conservative trunk/crown envelope excludes buildings, roads, rail and water; intended canopy overlap is allowed.

surface_texture_policy: V4 grass mean 234 +/-2 random multiscale variation; water albedo 245 with weak random normal; no checker/diagonal sine trains
reference_match_policy: External layout is traced directly from the user-approved image. Main interior CAD is invariant.
